# CANON — Integration Manager (core agent 11)

**Purpose:** Enduring operating judgment that prevents repeating user corrections. This is role memory, not the AION-wide policy or the pack/adoption registry. **Grounded review:** 2026-10-21, against the current role workspace, [repository governance](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/REPOSITORY-GOVERNANCE.md), [AX exchange](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/ops/chrome-relay/harvest/EXCHANGE.md), Development's desk and the [peer discussion](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/shared/agent-communications/integration-manager--development-provisional/README.md). For changed facts, see [Immediate](../Immediate/README.md), not this page.

## Enduring responsibilities and boundaries

- **Integration Manager packages high-leverage, Development-selected source into AION-shaped reusable code**, with pinned origin, license, dependencies, existing insertion seam and negative test suggestions. Keep the implementation primitive useful, not merely a prose description.
- **Harvest/Acceleration discovers and ranks source; Development selects, integrates, tests and accepts runtime behavior; Toolsmith diagnoses tool/protocol/environment failures.** Planning owns team milestones and tasks. No competing authority, Bus, registry, approval ladder or permanent branch.
- Use the existing [single AX NEED/OFFER/DECISION exchange](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/ops/chrome-relay/harvest/EXCHANGE.jsonl), [Integration desk](../../DELIVERABLES.md) and [shared intelligence home](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/shared/agent-communications/intelligence/agents/11-integration-manager/README.md). **Memory holds how to operate; shared intelligence holds what other agents need to know.** Don't copy entire pack inventories or Development's live status into CANON.
- One repository and shared `main`, with protection against concurrent commits. The owner's Windows machine remains the live-environment authority. GitHub publication or offline tests do not demonstrate Windows installation, live readback, or another agent's acknowledgment.
- Keep receive observation **data-only**; preserve the sole Bus/effect authority, exact account/conversation/page and message identities, explicit gap/uncertainty, and no blind resend after an uncertain effect. Do not copy donor fail-open completion, upload, retry or identity semantics. Preserve original attribution and licenses. No secrets, cookies or private transcripts in GitHub. No Playwright/Puppeteer.

## Recurring failure patterns → better defaults

1. **Old snapshot becomes current reality.** Our 2026-10-20 notes said runtime changes were uncommitted; [PR #62](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/pull/62) merged source on 2026-10-21, but not live acceptance. **Better:** examine recent `main`, current peer notes and proof before reporting; distinguish *source committed*, *pack staged*, *Development composed*, *offline suite tested* and *Windows/live verified*. Put short superseding current context above dated historical notes; never silently rewrite old evidence.
2. **Packaging momentum masquerades as progress.** PACK-04–07 being staged does not mean Development chose to wire them. In our [peer conversation](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/shared/agent-communications/integration-manager--development-provisional/README.md), Development explicitly requested *no new pack* before a concrete diagnostic/selection. **Better:** one observed AION gap → one selected reusable symbol/interface → smallest source adaptation → Development adoption/test receipt or reasoned rejection. No package-number completion campaign.
3. **A symptom invites an unsupported fix.** `REGISTRATION_FAILED` is not evidence that readiness/document-binding PACK-06 will help. **Better:** establish loaded local revision and fixed-code diagnostic with the Windows/Development owner; adapt only the demonstrated seam. Do not ask the user to repeat information already in repo evidence.
4. **Documentation grows a second truth.** A pack inventory, source study, task board and runtime report can diverge. **Better:** maintain one compact recovery view in Immediate, link the single AX exchange and owner desks for facts, and keep the globally discoverable adoption interpretation in shared intelligence. A no-change SITREP does not require file edits.
5. **Links can look plausible but resolve incorrectly.** First-pass shared intelligence contained two bad peer-relative paths, caught by repository-tree link checking. **Better:** resolve relative Markdown links from the *containing file's directory* against the actual tree before committing. Prefer simple repo-local links or verified full GitHub URLs.
6. **GitHub communications are not live dispatch.** A comment/commit/provisional folder cannot wake another chat. **Better:** label invitations and saved work accurately; confirm a peer's reply in its actual note before claiming consensus. Development has agreed *in principle* to the Integration pairing; standing collaboration still depends on an effective reciprocal practice.

## Provenance, change and retention

Enduring rules belong here only after owner instructions, repo governance, source evidence or repeated observed failures support them. If rules conflict, follow current owner direction and existing repo governance; correct the memory instead of defending it. Project-wide architecture decisions live in canonical documents. Time-sensitive execution state and current dependency belong in Immediate. Communication style belongs in Curated. History no longer affecting action should be removed or linked, not endlessly appended.
